title: Deleterious/Conservation IN — per-variant annotation request
description: One row per biallelic variant from the joint VCF. Provides the minimum context required to assign SnpEff consequence, SIFT4G class, VESM LLR, splice subclass, and per-variant burden score. Maps to MODULE_CONSERVATION steps 12–16 in the project.

variant_id.description: Canonical variant id '{chrom}:{pos}:{ref}:{alt}', post left-normalization, post bi-allelic split.

gff3_path.description: GFF3 annotation supplying gene_id, transcript_id, CDS coordinates, protein_id. Same file consumed by KBC for gene spans.

reference_fasta_path.description: Reference FASTA used for codon translation and splice-site dinucleotide checks.

database.description: SnpEff database name (built from the project GFF3 + reference).

protein_db_path.description: Path to the per-protein SIFT4G prediction directory.

validation_status.description: Status of the six-check validation gate in SPEC_KBC.md §1.9. Until 'passed', KBC Tier 2 stays disabled.

scoring_weights_path.description: Path to scoring_weights.tsv (consequence → weight). When null, per-variant weight defaults to 1.0.
